# CANDIDATE: VIX_DROP_BULLISH_PULLBACK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A rapid intraday decline in VIX signals reduced fear and often coincides with bullish momentum in SPY. Buying on VWAP pullbacks after such a VIX drop captures the shift from fear to greed, allowing entries at favorable prices during the early stages of a bullish leg.

## Mechanism

Compute 5-minute VIX change: if VIX drops >0.8 points (≈4%) from its value 30 minutes earlier AND price is above VWAP AND ribbon is bullish (EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50), wait for price to pull back to within 0.1% of VWAP (|price‑VWAP|/price < 0.001) and form a bullish candle (close > open); enter long at that candle’s close. For shorts: invert — VIX rises >0.8 points, price below VWAP, ribbon bearish, pullback to VWAP with bearish candle, enter short at close. Exit: stop at the recent swing low (long) or swing high (short); target at 1.5× risk or exit when VIX reverses >0.5 points in the opposite direction. Regime hints: best when VIX is between 15‑25 and time 10:00‑14:00 ET; avoid when VIX <12 or >35.
